1: library(readxl)
2: library(tidyr)
3: library(plyr)
4: library(dplyr)

8: # data used for Table A2
9: data <- read_xlsx("../../data/raw/data_power_to_people.xlsx")
10: 
11: 
12: # code for both tests -----------------------------------------------------
13: 
14: sign_comp_test <-  function(e1, se1, e2, se2){
15:   T1 = e1/se1
16:   T2 = e2/se2
17:   p1 = c(pnorm(T1, lower.tail = F),
18:          pnorm(T2, lower.tail = F))
19:   b1 <- min(p.adjust(p1, method = "bonferroni"))
20:   p2 = c(pnorm(T1, lower.tail = T),
21:          pnorm(T2, lower.tail = T))
22:   b2 = min(p.adjust(p2, method = "bonferroni"))
23:   return(max(b1, b2))
24: }
25: 
26: est_comp_test <- function(e1, se1, e2, se2){
27:  p = 2 * pnorm(abs(e1-e2)/sum(c(se1^2, se2^2)), lower.tail = F)
28:  return(p)
29: }
30: 
31: get_p_vals <- function(e1, se1, e2, se2){
32:   p1 = est_comp_test(e1, se1, e2, se2)
33:   p2 = sign_comp_test(e1, se1, e2, se2)
34:   return(c(p1, p2))
35: }
36: 
37: 
38: 
39: # Figure 2 ----------------------------------------------------------------
40: 
41: e <- seq(-4,4, by = .02)
42: 
43: # estimate comparison test
44: ec <- as.data.frame(expand.grid(e, e)) %>%
45:   mutate(p = est_comp_test(Var1, Var2, se1 = 1, se2 = 1),
46:          reg = cut(p, breaks = c(0, .01, .05, .1, 1), labels = 1:4),
47:          alpha = plyr::mapvalues(reg, from = 1:4, to = c(0.01, 0.05, 0.1, NA)),
48:          panel = "Estimate-comparison test")
49: 
50: # sign comparison test
51: sc <- as.data.frame(expand.grid(e, e)) 
52: 
53: sc$p <- mapply(FUN = sign_comp_test, e1 = sc$Var1, e2 = sc$Var2, se1 = 1, se2 = 1)
54: 
55: sc <- sc %>%
56:   mutate(
57:     reg = cut(p, breaks = c(0, .01, .05, .1, 1.1), labels = 1:4),
58:     alpha = plyr::mapvalues(reg, from = 1:4, to = c(0.01, 0.05, 0.1, NA)),
59:     panel = "Sign-comparison test")
60: 
61: # make figure
62: fig2 <- rbind(ec, sc) %>%
63:   as.data.frame() %>%
64:   filter(abs(Var1) <= 3 & abs(Var2) <= 3) %>%
65:   ggplot(aes(x = Var1, y = Var2, z = p)) +
66:   facet_grid(~panel) +
67:   geom_contour_filled(breaks=c(0,.01, 0.05, 0.1)) +
68:   scale_fill_manual(expression(alpha), values = c("#6baed6",
69:                                                   "#3182bd",
70:                                                   "#08519c"),
71:                     labels = c(0.01, 0.05, 0.1)) +
72:   theme_minimal() +
73:   scale_x_continuous(expression(paste(e[1]," (Estimate 1)"))) +
74:   scale_y_continuous(expression(paste(e[2]," (Estimate 2)"))) +
